rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a 2AB blastocyst, but it overstates certainty about specific visible structures (especially exact ICM location and TE characterization) and includes details not clearly discernible from the image.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is generally logical and well organized, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on SET and general transfer planning, but includes less guideline-supported suggestions such as ERA after failed transfers and urgent concern/escalation over AMH despite a good response.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer, luteal support, follow-up, and future planning, though some advice is somewhat generic and a few items are more speculative than necessary.
